name: ted-desktop
description: Ted - the AI assistant of Imoti Nadezhda as a desktop program for Windows and Mac
author: Imoti Nadezhda

scripts.dist:win: npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never && node scripts/sha256.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac dmg --universal --publish never
scripts.build:web: vite build --mode web && rm -rf ../../mobile/ted && cp -r dist-web ../../mobile/ted
